title: Lightbox onboarding slate: model flow + request builder + code snips
creator: Arielle Chen
description: Produce a compact 'lightbox' style screenshot bundle for the Hosted API getting-started flow. The deliverables should include annotated visuals for: 1) model selector (tier/latency/cost badges, compatibility hints), 2) request builder UI (preset templates, streaming toggle, function/tool calling toggle, param hints), 3) three code snippet cards (Node.js async streaming, Python sync example, curl minimal request) and 4) a short annotated overlay showing where to find API keys, quota info, and example response structure. Focus is on small-canvas assets suitable for docs header, quickstart guide, and social share cards.
acceptance_criteria: Three distinct screenshot sizes: hero (1200x630), doc tile (900x450), and narrow mobile portrait (420x800)
Each screenshot includes accessible alt copy and a short caption for doc use
Code snippets are runnable with minimal edits and include comments about streaming vs non-streaming behavior
Model selector shows clear selection state and an inline latency/cost microbadge
Request builder shows function calling toggle and a small example structured output panel
Figma file with component variants and export-ready frames shared to drive and linked in ticket
timeline: 2026-03-10: ticket created, kickoff with PM + Eng; scoped hero + tile + mobile frames
2026-03-11: first-pass comps uploaded to Figma; requested copy variants from technical writer
2026-03-12: engineering review completed; Eng asked to add streaming indicator and function-calling example
2026-03-12: design review scheduled, accessibility pass initiated
decisions: Use monospace + subtle syntax highlighting for code cards (primary color tokens are blue and amber)
Show latency and estimated token cost as microbadges next to model names rather than in the info panel to reduce clicks
Prefer a single-column mobile stack: model selector > request builder > code snippet accordion
Mask API key in screenshots; show 'Reveal' toggle in overlay rather than exposing secrets
review_feedback: PM (Diego Ramos): Add a short line under code snippets explaining quota and fallback model behavior
Eng (Sofia Patel): Include a small KV-cache icon in the request builder to communicate prefix caching when enabled
Technical Writer (Liam O'Neill): Simplify comments in code snippets to 1-2 lines max for readability
Security (Anya Volkov): Ensure no PII or real API tokens in exports; confirm Drive folder permissions
tradeoffs: Tight canvas sizes require cropping of the Console header; we prioritize visible request-builder inputs over full nav context
Showing cost microbadges inline increases visual density vs hiding them behind tooltips — chose inline for faster product comprehension
Including both streaming and non-streaming samples increases copy but improves real-world fidelity for developers
next_steps: Apply accessibility contrast fixes (button states and microbadge text) — due 2026-03-13
Export frame sets in PNG and SVG optimized for docs (multiple DPRs) — due 2026-03-15
Link exported assets into PR docs update (docs PR #5123) and console PR #2768
Schedule final stakeholder review (PM/Eng/Security) and close ticket once PRs merge
